highlights.title: InferScale: GPU-Native KV Injection for Personalized LLM Serving
highlights.summary: InferScale is a GPU-native LLM memory system.
highlights.detail: InferScale replaces repeated prompt prefilling with reusable KV state, reducing time-to-first-token. It precomputes each memory fact's KV representation and stores it alongside a semantic embedding on the GPU.

highlights.title: OmegaUse-OfficeVal: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Office-Suite Tasks with Economic Grounding
highlights.summary: OmegaUse-OfficeVal benchmarks LLM agents on office-suite tasks.
highlights.detail: The benchmark provides economic grounding, enabling direct comparisons between human costs and LLM inference costs. It supports stable evaluation with code-based tasks.

highlights.title: AgentMap: Joint Equivalence and Subsumption Discovery for Ontology Matching
highlights.summary: AgentMap is an LLM-based ontology matching framework.
highlights.detail: AgentMap integrates semantic retrieval, hierarchical search, and collaborative multi-agent LLM reasoning to identify equivalent concepts or subsumers. It extends four OM datasets for a HOM benchmark.

highlights.title: Upcoming: Codeforces Round (Div. 2)
highlights.detail: The contest will last for 2 hours and will start on August 6 at 14:35 UTC.

highlights.title: How enabling two settings tripled our scores on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark
highlights.summary: Two API settings tripled scores on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark.
highlights.detail: The settings improved GPT-5.6 performance by retaining reasoning and enabling compaction, boosting scores and efficiency.

items.title: [$] Debugging information for inlined functions
items.summary: BPF type format to include inlined functions
items.detail: The addition of inlined functions to BTF will allow for better tracing and debugging of kernel functions. This is particularly useful for BPF programs.

items.title: GCC steering committee announces AI policy
items.summary: GCC steering committee announces AI policy
items.detail: The policy states that the project will decline any legally significant contributions that include LLM-generated content. However, LLMs can be used for research and analysis.

items.title: Hybrid Workflow Composition for Extreme-Scale Data Processing: A Case Study on the HL-LHC (Extended Version)
items.summary: Hybrid workflow composition for extreme-scale data processing
items.detail: The paper presents a novel simulation framework for characterizing the interplay between taskset granularity and system-level constraints. Hybrid composition strategies can yield significant throughput increases.

items.title: Deductive Verification for Earliest Deadline First Scheduler Implementations
items.summary: Deductive verification for earliest deadline first scheduler
items.detail: The paper proposes a framework for deductive verification of EDF scheduler implementations. The framework utilizes deductive verification to ensure the correctness of the scheduler.

items.title: Unified Shared Memory in OpenMP: Implementation, Programmability, and Performance on Intel Accelerators
items.summary: Unified shared memory in OpenMP
items.detail: The paper discusses the implementation and adoption of unified shared memory in OpenMP. The feature simplifies the adoption of the OpenMP programming model.

items.title: DualDecoder: Accelerate Long Context LLM Inference by Predictive Prefetch
items.summary: DualDecoder for long context LLM inference
items.detail: The paper presents a lightweight serving system for long-context LLM inference. The system enables efficient sparse KV cache retrieval from host memory.

items.title: ServerlessT2I: Efficient Text-to-Image Workflow Serving on a Serverless Platform
items.summary: ServerlessT2I for efficient text-to-image workflow serving
items.detail: The paper presents a serverless-native system for text-to-image workflow serving. The system decomposes the workflow into loosely coupled model functions for efficient management and scheduling.

items.title: A Graph-Native Bitemporal Memory Store for Conversational AI Agents
items.summary: Graph-native bitemporal memory store for conversational AI
items.detail: The paper describes a memory store that avoids exhausting the model's context budget or sending personal data through infrastructure the user does not control. The store uses a Neo4j property graph with HNSW vector indexes.

items.title: geo-tp/ESP32-Bit-Pirate
items.summary: ESP32-Bit-Pirate hardware hacking tool
items.detail: The tool is a hardware hacking tool with a web-based CLI that speaks every protocol. It is designed for use with the ESP32 microcontroller.

items.title: tracel-ai/burn
items.summary: Burn is a tensor library and Deep Learning Framework.
items.detail: It aims to provide flexibility, efficiency, and portability. Burn is written in Rust, which contributes to its performance and reliability.

items.title: obra/superpowers
items.summary: Obra is an agentic skills framework.
items.detail: It provides a software development methodology that focuses on agent-based approaches. This framework can be applied to various domains and industries.

items.title: qxcnm/Codex-Manager
items.summary: Codex-Manager is a CLI account manager.
items.detail: It provides a local gateway for Codex CLI, enabling users to manage and switch accounts easily. This tool is written in Rust.

items.title: sgl-project/sglang
items.summary: SGLang is a serving framework for language models.
items.detail: It supports large language models and multimodal models, focusing on high-performance serving. SGLang is written in Python.

items.title: superradcompany/microsandbox
items.summary: Microsandbox is a local-first microVM runtime.
items.detail: It provides an easy and fast way to run microVMs locally. Microsandbox is written in Rust, which ensures its performance and security.
